title: Embeddings + Rerank: First-time Flow assets and snapshot gallery
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, card-driven quickstart that introduces embeddings + rerank for first-time users. Includes: a linear pipeline ribbon (ingest → embedding → candidate retrieval → rerank → results), a snapshot gallery of sample outputs (input → vector similarity list → rerank scores + highlights), accessibility annotations, localized copy variants, and export-ready artboards for docs and in-console help. Deliverables: Figma file with components, annotated PNG exports for docs, a short animated GIF showing rerank score transitions, and a developer-facing spec that enumerates analytics events and alt text.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains pipeline ribbon component with 3 density variants (compact, default, expanded)
Snapshot gallery includes 6 sample queries with original results + rerank overlays and delta explanations
Exported PNGs sized for docs (1200x600) and Console help widget (800x320) available in Drive
Animated GIF demonstrates rerank reordering and score fade-in, under 3MB
Accessibility doc lists alt text, keyboard focus order, and color contrast tokens
Design handoff spec enumerates analytics events and copy tokens for i18n
